safety_gates: Never count programme components as independent unique prayers.
No import of a full modern translation or 2020 authored text before rights check.
Public PDFs: page-image verification proves what the PDF prints, not ancient textual originality.
No changes to canonical prayer readers, 1962 Mass or Calendar.
Document-cover references do not certify ritual text or rubrics.
French association formulas on website are excerpts not full certified prayers.
